description: Start a reading plan for the user by plan id (from list_reading_plans or create_reading_plan). A plan the user paused earlier resumes where it left off; otherwise day 1 begins today. Returns the plan name, length and today's passage. Fails with a conflict if a plan is already active; that plan is paused or finished in Selah first.

plan_id.description: UUID of the plan, from list_reading_plans or create_reading_plan.

name: start_reading_plan
title: Start reading plan
